model.name: dc-battery-sim
model.label: DC Battery Simulator
model.description: Discrete-time second-order RC equivalent-circuit Li-ion battery model with thermal dynamics and temperature derating. Publishes state every SAMPLE_TIME seconds.

signals.name: requested_power_w
signals.label: Requested Power
signals.description: DC power setpoint. Negative discharges the pack, positive charges it.

signals.name: ambient_temp_c
signals.label: Ambient Temperature
signals.description: Air temperature surrounding the pack. Drives the KE heat-exchange term.

signals.name: chiller_setting
signals.label: Chiller
signals.description: Active cooling stage. Removes 0 / 2500 / 5000 W of heat and enables the COOLANT_TEMP lower clamp when non-zero.

signals.name: heater_setting
signals.label: Heater
signals.description: Active heating stage. Adds 0 / 2500 / 5000 W of heat.

signals.name: soc_percent
signals.label: State of Charge
signals.description: Stored charge as a percentage of Q_max. Starts at 50 % (q_act = Q_max / 2).

signals.name: q_act_as
signals.label: Stored Charge
signals.description: Actual stored charge in Coulombs (ampere-seconds), from Coulomb counting.

signals.name: ocv_v
signals.label: Open-Circuit Voltage
signals.description: OCV from the linear SOC look-up: 720 V at 0 % SOC, 840 V at 100 % SOC.

signals.name: dc_voltage_v
signals.label: Terminal Voltage
signals.description: DC terminal voltage = OCV − R0·I − V_RC1 − V_RC2.

signals.name: dc_current_a
signals.label: DC Current
signals.description: DC current after temperature derating. Negative = discharge, positive = charge.

signals.name: rc1_voltage_v
signals.label: RC1 Branch Voltage
signals.description: Fast charge-transfer polarisation voltage. Zero while R1 = 0.

signals.name: rc2_voltage_v
signals.label: RC2 Branch Voltage
signals.description: Slow diffusion polarisation voltage. Zero while R2 = 0.

signals.name: temperature_c
signals.label: Battery Temperature
signals.description: Pack temperature after upper (MAX_BATTERY_TEMP) and chiller-conditional lower (COOLANT_TEMP) saturation.

signals.name: heat_j
signals.label: Accumulated Heat
signals.description: Heat energy state, back-calculated from the saturated temperature so that T = A_THERMAL × Heat always holds.

signals.name: derating_factor
signals.label: Derating Factor
signals.description: Temperature derating multiplier applied to dc_current_a. 1.0 = full power, 0.0 = fully derated.

signals.name: requested_power_w
signals.label: Requested Power (echo)
signals.description: Power setpoint the model actually applied on this tick. Echo of the input signal of the same name.

signals.name: ambient_temp_c
signals.label: Ambient Temperature (echo)
signals.description: Ambient temperature the model actually applied on this tick. Echo of the input signal of the same name.

parameters.name: Q_MAX_AH
parameters.label: Pack Capacity
parameters.description: Maximum charge capacity. Converted internally to Coulombs (Q_max = Q_MAX_AH × 3600). FIXED: SOC = q_act / Q_max, so a mid-run change steps the SOC reading.

parameters.name: SAMPLE_TIME
parameters.label: Sample Time
parameters.description: Simulation step and publish period. FIXED: it sets the loop rate and both RC filter coefficients, so a mid-run change breaks continuity twice over.

parameters.name: A_THERMAL
parameters.label: Heat-to-Temperature Coefficient
parameters.description: Converts accumulated heat to temperature: T = A_THERMAL × Heat. Must stay strictly positive — the model divides by it when back-calculating heat after saturation.

parameters.name: KT0
parameters.label: Thermal Constant Term
parameters.description: Current-independent heat generation. Default 0 — the model has no idle heat source.

parameters.name: KT1
parameters.label: Thermal Linear Current Coefficient
parameters.description: Heat generation proportional to current. Default 0 — heating is symmetric for charge and discharge.

parameters.name: KT2
parameters.label: Thermal Quadratic Current Coefficient
parameters.description: Ohmic self-heating, proportional to current squared. Derived so that |I| = 300 A gives +1 °C per 2 s.

parameters.name: KE
parameters.label: Ambient Heat Exchange Coefficient
parameters.description: Heat lost to ambient per degree of difference. Derived from equilibrium at |20 A| with a 13 °C ambient (τ ≈ 52 min).

parameters.name: TAU1
parameters.label: RC1 Time Constant
parameters.description: Fast charge-transfer relaxation time (τ₁ = R1·C1). Changing it recomputes ALPHA1 = exp(−SAMPLE_TIME / TAU1). Zero disables the RC1 lag.

parameters.name: TAU2
parameters.label: RC2 Time Constant
parameters.description: Slow diffusion relaxation time (τ₂ = R2·C2). Changing it recomputes ALPHA2 = exp(−SAMPLE_TIME / TAU2). Zero disables the RC2 lag.

parameters.name: R0
parameters.label: Series Resistance
parameters.description: Internal series resistance. Non-zero makes the terminal-voltage loop implicit and engages the quadratic current solver.

parameters.name: R1
parameters.label: RC1 Branch Resistance
parameters.description: Charge-transfer polarisation resistance. Zero holds rc1_voltage_v at 0 V.

parameters.name: R2
parameters.label: RC2 Branch Resistance
parameters.description: Diffusion polarisation resistance. Zero holds rc2_voltage_v at 0 V.

parameters.name: COOLANT_TEMP
parameters.label: Coolant Temperature
parameters.description: Lower clamp on pack temperature while the chiller is running. Has no effect when chiller_setting is 0.

parameters.name: MAX_BATTERY_TEMP
parameters.label: Max Battery Temperature
parameters.description: Hard upper clamp on pack temperature. Capped at 60 °C because the derating LUT returns 0 at and above 60 °C — a higher clamp leaves the pack permanently derated to zero current.
